title: Lemony Chicken & Courgette Carbonara
description: A lighter carbonara with pan-fried chicken, courgette, lemon zest and juice tossed through spaghetti in an egg yolk and Parmesan sauce.
ingredients: finely grated zest and juice of 2 unwaxed lemons
2 courgettes (~250g), sliced into 3mm pieces then halved
steps: Simmer spaghetti in a large pan of boiling water for 11 minutes.
Beat egg yolks in a medium bowl; beat in Parmesan.
Fry chicken over high heat in cooking spray until no pink showing (~3 minutes). Add garlic, lemon zest and juice; season. Keep frying gently while spaghetti cooks.
When pasta nearly ready, take a ladleful of pasta water, add to egg mixture and mix in thoroughly.
Stir courgette pieces in with the chicken.
Drain spaghetti; remove chicken pan from heat; add spaghetti then egg mixture. Stir until everything coated with sauce.
Serve with chopped parsley and more pepper.
notes: Swap chicken for bacon and leave out lemon juice and zest for a more traditional carbonara.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
